packing_tips: Pack breathable layers (mornings/evenings can feel cooler near the water), comfortable slip-resistant sandals for uneven historic streets, a light rain layer, swimwear, sunscreen, and a small day bag. Bring a reusable water bottle and any motion-sickness medication if you’re sensitive on boats.
travel_tips: Use slower transport options (private transfer or taxis where possible) to reduce fatigue. Build in long recovery breaks between ocean and mountain/garden time. For overwhelmed energy, prioritize sitting-friendly viewpoints and gardens, and keep walk time short with frequent pauses.
